## Overview

- Launch the MarkdStage UI directly from the CLI.
- Improve preview defaults, clipped slide layouts, and startup layout messaging.
- Keep the Canvas Extension, Agent Skills, CLI, and Desktop on the unified 3.4.0 release.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible for existing Markdown decks. No migration is required.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v3.4.0`. |
| CLI presentation | Use the CLI's presentation command to launch the MarkdStage UI when a desktop preview is needed. |
